mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model (id, name, display_name, description, model_source, storage_backend, storage_path, file_size_mb, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{modelSource}, #{storageBackend}, #{storagePath}, #{fileSizeMb}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE model SET name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, model_source = #{modelSource}, storage_backend = #{storageBackend}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, file_size_mb = #{fileSizeMb}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model ORDER BY created_at DESC
